cards.audioText: How does a SNOWTAM differ from other Notices to Airmen (NOTAMs)?
cards.audioTextZh: 雪情通告（SNOWTAM）与其他航行通告（NOTAM）有何不同？
cards.referenceText: A NOTAM provides general operational information about changes to facilities, services, procedures, or hazards. A SNOWTAM is a specific type of NOTAM used to report snow, ice, or slush conditions on runways, taxiways, and aprons. In short, every SNOWTAM is a NOTAM, but most NOTAMs are not SNOWTAMs.
cards.referenceTextZh: 航行通告提供有关设施、服务、程序或危险变化的一般运行信息。雪情通告是航行通告的一种专门形式，用于报告跑道、滑行道和机坪上的雪、冰或雪浆状况。简而言之，每份雪情通告都是航行通告，但大多数航行通告不是雪情通告。
